excelRendering: LibreOffice explicitly selected. Excel-only image exports approved standard searchable PDF without per-cell accessibility tags or PDF/UA; this avoids object expansion on long tables while retaining visible content. Internal charts and SC CJK open-font substitutions remain; macro execution/OLE automation are disabled, external-link blocking and the LO sandbox remain enabled. Saved worksheet formula values are frozen without recalculation. Preflight rejects OLE, macros and external image/data relationships.
isolation: One disposable container per task, internal network, no public ports or host document mounts; shared bounded Office queue.
promotionPolicy: Excel is disabled by default in the API and production frontend. Verify fonts, licenses, exact image and outputs on the target host before enabling. Never replace the approved Word image pin.
